quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: If the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency: (1) Approaches the driver’s vehicle, proceed as required pursuant to subsection 1 [NRS-484B-267-1a, NRS-484B-267-1b, NRS-484B-267-1c]; or (2) Stops, proceed as required pursuant to NRS 484B.607 [NRS-484B-607-1a, NRS-484B-607-1b, NRS-484B-607-1c, NRS-484B-607-1d]. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: Ego approaches authorized emergency or regulatory official vehicle moving or visibly preparing to move, using qualifying flashing lights; unit approaches ego for the selected referral.

obligation.description: Proceed as required pursuant to subsection 1; unavailable 1a and 1b duties are not inferred.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Source-bound law-enforcement direction can alter the driver's response.

timing.description: Observe both approach relationships, movement or visible preparation, and response over the original 45 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Observe original relative routes, positions and unit motion without a numeric legal cutoff.
Observe visible hand signals or original unit movement before approach.

parameter_refs.name: light_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: qualified active, qualified inactive or unqualified active
